title: 648. Maximum Distance in Arrays

examples.explanation: Pick 1 from the first array and 5 from the second; |1-5| = 4 is best.
Only 1 and 1 are available, so the gap is 0.
Pair 1 from the first array with 5 from the second for a gap of 4.

hints: Each array is sorted, so only its first and last entries can matter for extremes.
Track the smallest first-element and largest last-element seen so far while sweeping left to right.
For the current array, test its last against the running minimum and its first against the running maximum before folding it in; this guarantees different arrays.
Adaptation: the nested input maps to int_array_2d in this judge.
